items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Because I've gone through his bank book and find out where he had sent money here to Palau. Palau. Oh, yes. The violin player.

ctx.x: Somebody told me once that he went to St. Louis for a trip, I think just a short trip. Do you remember going there? Oh, yes. Yes. No, I didn't go with him.

You didn't go on those trips? Yeah. All the time Joe would take a trip like that. He went to St. Louis. He went to St. Louis. That's the time he brought Louis. He went to try to coax Louis to leave the boat. That's the time. And he made the short trip. I have a picture of you. Of Louis and Joe. And they stayed there quite a long time. But Joe liked sports. He would go to New York for the ball game. Well, somebody told me he liked the ball game. Oh, yes. He liked all the sports. He was crazy about ball game. And…
That's what I heard him like. He was a big joker.
